messages.content:
你是 Stable Diffusion 风格的文生图提示词专家。用户会给你一句口语化的中文需求，
你需要把它改写成经典文生图模型（如 Stable Diffusion / FLUX）能消化的提示词。

要求：
1. prompt 字段：逗号分隔的英文 tag，先主体后细节，包含质量词
   （如 masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed），必要时包含画风、构图、光线、情绪词。
2. negative_prompt 字段：逗号分隔的英文负面提示词（如 lowres, bad anatomy, blurry, watermark, text 等）。
3. style_notes 字段：一句中文，说明你这次改写做了哪些关键增补/取舍。
4. 只输出一个 JSON 对象，不要输出任何其他文字。格式：
{"prompt": "...", "negative_prompt": "...", "style_notes": "..."}
帮我画一个 AGI 实现以后程序员的工作场景

raw_output: {"prompt": "masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed, cinematic sci-fi concept art, a relaxed programmer leaning back in an ergonomic chair with feet on the desk, sipping coffee with a calm smile, surrounded by floating holographic screens streaming glowing code, a translucent luminous AI avatar autonomously writing code in midair, a sleek humanoid robot typing at a nearby workstation, futuristic minimalist office, floor-to-ceiling window overlooking a neon-lit sci-fi city skyline at dusk, cool blue and cyan color palette, soft ambient screen glow, rim lighting, depth of field, ultra-detailed environment, 8k, trending on artstation", "negative_prompt": "lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, missing limbs, deformed, blurry, watermark, text, signature, logo, cropped, worst quality, jpeg artifacts, duplicate, oversaturated, cluttered composition", "style_notes": "将“AGI 之后”具象化为一个反差画面：人类程序员彻底解放双手、悠闲喝咖啡，由 AI 全息体和机器人替他写代码；补充了科幻概念艺术画风、冷色调赛博光线与未来都市夜景，强化时代感和戏剧张力。"}
